item.title: Agents are breaking AI economics, and the fix starts in the data layer
item.description:
When companies talk about the cost of artificial intelligence, the conversation almost always starts with models: which one to use, what it costs per million tokens, and whether a smaller model is “good enough.” That made sense when AI meant a chatbot.
